correctness.rationale: Exact orthonormal Dirichlet columns give the Hilbert–Schmidt Bessel series. Fixed-phase exponential separation establishes the iff criterion including the endpoint. A compact factorization handles the full bounded range c>a. The 67 packaged computations are supplementary rather than infinite proof.
